misclassified_events.root_cause: AttackTimelineReconstructor (src/network_anomaly/trace/timeline.py:121-123) matches lateral movement only on keywords ['lateral', 'internal', 'worm', 'smb'] or internal ports (445, 139, 3389, 22), missing WinRM ports (5985/5986) and falling through to the default INITIAL_ACCESS branch (timeline.py:135).

qualitative_error_analysis.missed_link_example: If an attacker pivots across hosts (e.g., 198.51.100.1 -> 10.0.0.1 followed by 10.0.0.2 -> 10.0.0.4) without an explicit EntityRelationshipGraph CONNECTS_TO edge, single-IP log grep stops at the perimeter host and misses lateral hops ev-5..ev-8.
qualitative_error_analysis.false_link_example: On shared NAT gateways or admin bastions (e.g., 10.0.0.2), purely IP-based CONNECTS_TO edges can falsely merge benign administrative WinRM/RDP traffic into an active incident cluster if behavioral or temporal window constraints are not enforced.
qualitative_error_analysis.sample_size_caveat: Benchmark uses N=10 synthetic events across 4 ATT&CK phases; each single event represents 10.0 percentage points of accuracy, so results are illustrative functional verification rather than production telemetry statistics.
